newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade inactive - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade inactive - USDA.

text.p: Trade was inactive in the Panhandle area early Tuesday, USDA. Slaughter steers and heifers not tested. Feedlots reporting light to moderate inquiry from buyers.

There were 32,800 head confirmed for the week which includes 26,800 formulated cattle and 4,600 head or 113 loads CME cattle delivered. The last established price was $65.00 per cwt on Monday. Tuesday's packer bids were $64.00-$65.00 with asking prices $66.00-$68.00.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink. Confirmed - None
